## Editorial research notes

The existing research notes report that the project is a fan-made replacement cinematic pack based on processing existing video with AI upscaling and motion compensation. They report claims of threefold image upscaling, conversion from 25 to 60 frames per second, and replacement files being placed in the cinematics directory. They also report an “all versions” compatibility claim.

These statements are retained as unverified research notes, not as a transcription or quotation from the ModDB page. The files and embedded media were not downloaded or viewed, so visual quality, compatibility, filenames, download sizes, and comments could not be checked.
